DAT_0014.name: flash_chip_flags
DAT_0014.brief: Flags byte of the identified chip; bit 1 = status registers written one by one.

DAT_0022.name: flash_jedec_command
DAT_0022.brief: The command byte 0x9F (Read JEDEC ID) sent by the ID read.

DAT_0023.name: flash_jedec_answer
DAT_0023.brief: The four answer bytes of the JEDEC ID read.

DAT_002f.name: flash_quad_capable_flag
DAT_002f.brief: Set when the identified chip can read in quad mode (chip flags bit 0).

DAT_0030.name: flash_chip_index
DAT_0030.brief: Index of the identified chip from the chip table (maker only: low nibble 0xF).

DAT_0031.name: flash_erase_opcode
DAT_0031.brief: Sector erase opcode of the chip: 0xD7 for maker 0x7F, else 0x20.

DAT_0032.name: flash_size_code
DAT_0032.brief: The 16-bit size code of the identified chip.

DAT_08.name: startup_marker_bytes
DAT_08.brief: IDATA bytes 0x08.. searched for the marker 0x60 when the clock variant is not 0x20.

DAT_0e.name: startup_marker_bytes_slow_clock
DAT_0e.brief: IDATA bytes 0x0E.. searched for the marker 0x30 when the clock variant is 0x20 (the slower clock).

DAT_CODE_4000.name: flash_chip_table
DAT_CODE_4000.brief: The 57 known flash chips: index, maker, memory type, capacity, size code, flags.

DAT_CODE_6000.name: startup_partition_table
DAT_CODE_6000.brief: The partition table at CODE 0x6000 (0x7000 for slot 1).

DAT_EXTMEM_3000.name: startup_share_block
DAT_EXTMEM_3000.brief: The share block that the boot loader fills for the next program.

DAT_EXTMEM_a000.name: startup_partition_entries
DAT_EXTMEM_a000.brief: The 12-byte descriptors built from the partition table for the share block.

DAT_EXTMEM_f050.name: reg_flash_read_mode
DAT_EXTMEM_f050.brief: Flash mode bits: bit 2 quad read (0x6B), bit 5 dual read (0x3B).

DAT_EXTMEM_f064.name: reg_flash_jedec_maker
DAT_EXTMEM_f064.brief: JEDEC ID byte 0: the maker of the flash chip.

DAT_EXTMEM_f065.name: reg_flash_jedec_mem_type
DAT_EXTMEM_f065.brief: JEDEC ID byte 1: the memory type.

DAT_EXTMEM_f066.name: reg_flash_jedec_capacity
DAT_EXTMEM_f066.brief: JEDEC ID byte 2: the capacity code.

DAT_EXTMEM_f0e5.name: reg_flash_spi_start
DAT_EXTMEM_f0e5.brief: SPI start register: bit 0 starts a transfer, bit 1 a read; each clears when done.

DAT_EXTMEM_f0e6.name: reg_flash_spi_mode
DAT_EXTMEM_f0e6.brief: SPI mode register: bits 2-3 = bus mode, low bits = transfer kind (0x41, 1).

DAT_EXTMEM_f0ea.name: reg_flash_read_opcode
DAT_EXTMEM_f0ea.brief: The read opcode of the flash controller (0x6B, 0x3B, 0x0B or a command).

DAT_EXTMEM_f0ee.name: reg_flash_command
DAT_EXTMEM_f0ee.brief: The first byte (opcode) of a flash command.

DAT_EXTMEM_f0ef.name: reg_flash_read_byte
DAT_EXTMEM_f0ef.brief: The byte that a one-byte read command returns.

DAT_EXTMEM_f0f0.name: reg_flash_addr_f0f0
DAT_EXTMEM_f0f0.brief: Address register written with address bits 24-31 by the stream read.

DAT_EXTMEM_f0f1.name: reg_flash_addr_f0f1
DAT_EXTMEM_f0f1.brief: Address register written with address bits 16-23 by the stream read.

DAT_EXTMEM_f0f2.name: reg_flash_addr_f0f2
DAT_EXTMEM_f0f2.brief: Address register written with address bits 0-7 by the stream read.

DAT_EXTMEM_f0f4.name: reg_flash_transfer_type
DAT_EXTMEM_f0f4.brief: Transfer type: (command length << 5) | 0x13, 0x0B stream read, 0x07 one-byte read.

DAT_EXTMEM_f11c.name: reg_gpio_port12
DAT_EXTMEM_f11c.evidence: XDATA 0xF11C, the register the 8051 application drives through gpio_set_port_bits / gpio_write_port as port 12; set here by flash_setup_bus_mode

DAT_EXTMEM_f11d.name: reg_gpio_port12_partner
DAT_EXTMEM_f11d.evidence: XDATA 0xF11D, the register the 8051 application writes through gpio_write_port_partner as port 12; changed here by flash_setup_bus_mode

DAT_EXTMEM_f1c0.name: reg_flash_fifo_f1c0
DAT_EXTMEM_f1c0.brief: FIFO register: write mode 0x82 / 0x84, stream mode 0x81, read data of the stream.

DAT_EXTMEM_f1c3.name: reg_flash_fifo_write
DAT_EXTMEM_f1c3.brief: FIFO data register for the command bytes after the opcode.

DAT_EXTMEM_f1c8.name: reg_flash_fifo_f1c8
DAT_EXTMEM_f1c8.brief: FIFO register: mode 0x81 / 0x82, then the answer bytes of a transfer.

DAT_EXTMEM_f1d0.name: reg_copy_start
DAT_EXTMEM_f1d0.brief: Copy register: 0x87 starts the hardware copy of the next program.

DAT_EXTMEM_f1d3.name: reg_copy_addr_f1d3
DAT_EXTMEM_f1d3.brief: Copy register: partition table byte 3 (flash address of the next program).

DAT_EXTMEM_f1d4.name: reg_copy_addr_f1d4
DAT_EXTMEM_f1d4.brief: Copy register: partition table byte 2 (flash address of the next program).

DAT_EXTMEM_f1d5.name: reg_copy_addr_f1d5
DAT_EXTMEM_f1d5.brief: Copy register: partition table byte 1 (flash address of the next program).

DAT_EXTMEM_f1d6.name: reg_copy_size_f1d6
DAT_EXTMEM_f1d6.brief: Copy register: partition table byte 7 (size of the next program).

DAT_EXTMEM_f1d7.name: reg_copy_size_f1d7
DAT_EXTMEM_f1d7.brief: Copy register: partition table byte 6 (size of the next program).

DAT_EXTMEM_f1d8.name: reg_copy_size_f1d8
DAT_EXTMEM_f1d8.brief: Copy register: partition table byte 5 (size of the next program).

DAT_d511.name: reg_sys_clock_variant
DAT_d511.brief: Chip register read as the clock variant: 0x20 selects the 48 MHz UART clock, any other value 96 MHz.
DAT_d511.evidence: startup_is_slow_clock compares it with 0x20; uart_init picks 48 or 96 MHz by the answer

DAT_f064.name: reg_flash_jedec_id
DAT_f064.brief: The three JEDEC ID bytes of the flash chip (maker, memory type, capacity).
